name: 3',3'-cGAMP riboswitch bound to cyclic-AMP-GMP
source: RCSB PDB 4YAZ; Kellenberger CA et al. Science 2015 doi:10.1126/science.1261622
notes: GEMM-Ib riboswitch from Geobacter metallireducens. Ligand 4BW (3',3'-cGAMP). Mixed-linkage cyclic dinucleotide. 2.00A X-ray. Complements c-di-GMP-I/II and c-di-AMP.
affinitySource: Kellenberger CA et al. 2015; Kd ~1 uM for 3,3-cGAMP
affinityNotes: GEMM-Ib riboswitch binds 3,3-cGAMP (mixed-linkage). Completes cyclic dinucleotide family.
